description: This file contains helper functions, builders, and string representations related to Kubernetes RBAC policies, including resource matching, subject string formatting, and policy rule construction.

classes.name: PolicyRuleBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing PolicyRule objects with validation.

classes.name: ClusterRoleBindingBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing ClusterRoleBinding objects with subject management.

classes.name: RoleBindingBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing RoleBinding objects with subject management.

classes.name: SortableRuleSlice
classes.description: A sortable slice of PolicyRule objects.

methods.name: ResourceMatches
methods.description: Checks if a rule resource matches a requested resource, including wildcards and subresources.

methods.name: SubjectsStrings
methods.description: Returns string slices of users, groups, service accounts, and others from a list of subjects.

methods.name: PolicyRule.String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a PolicyRule.

methods.name: PolicyRule.CompactString
methods.description: Returns a compact string representation of a PolicyRule for escalation messages.

methods.name: NewRule
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyRuleBuilder with specified verbs.

methods.name: combine
methods.description: Combines two string slices into one, using sets to avoid duplicates.

methods.name: PolicyRuleBuilder.Rule
methods.description: Validates and returns the constructed PolicyRule.

methods.name: ClusterRoleBindingBuilder.Binding
methods.description: Builds and returns the ClusterRoleBinding object, validating subjects.

methods.name: ClusterRoleBindingBuilder.BindingOrDie
methods.description: Builds the ClusterRoleBinding or panics on error.

methods.name: RoleBindingBuilder.Binding
methods.description: Builds and returns the RoleBinding object, validating subjects.

methods.name: RoleBindingBuilder.BindingOrDie
methods.description: Builds the RoleBinding or panics on error.
